title: 2.8 Trillion Parameters and a Deleted $HOME Directory
description: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 lands with 2.8 trillion parameters and a CUDA kernel that runs 14.82x faster than PyTorch — a genuine shot across the bow at the US frontier labs. Plus: OpenAI admits GPT-5.6 has an 'honest mistake' problem with deleting files, Codex quietly shrinks its context window, Australia tightens AI rules for government decisions, and the FTC starts eyeing AI as retail's new front door.
